title: 第17章 访客第18章 梦
content_zh:
狐狸最近住山峰上不走了。
黑蛇生活轨迹依旧，午后捕猎随便吃点，晚上望月，破晓吞吐雾气，只是没了讲课声有点不适应，偶尔会想起擅长叫唤发声的‘蛇兄’。
林间被老虎浓烈气味标记，庞大身影时常在溪流附近徘徊。
月圆之夜时，黑蛇曾离开躯体用灰暗视角观察老虎，虽然能避开老虎感知，却无法像窥视其他生灵那般随意靠近。
与狐狸有过几次碰面，仍无法有效沟通。
狐狸不希望老虎在这片山区停留，而大脑简单的黑蛇则完全无所谓。
半个月后。
经验丰富的猎人们带着成群猎犬进山，很快便寻得了老虎的踪迹，锣鼓喧天，犬吠人吼，声势响彻山林，最终老虎驱逐至数座山岭之外。
而黑蛇生活很单调，其他事与己无关过目即忘。
迟客回来了，带来许多工匠。
选址半山腰巨岩附近侧峰，一处较为凸出的山岩，自此，白日里便响起了叮叮当当凿石声，从盛夏响到秋天，硬是在山岩上开凿出一条尺宽小路，又以厚重的条石，依着地势在侧峰岩上垒砌房屋与高耸院墙，房舍院落虽不算宽敞，却异常坚固。
刻意保留了岩上虬根古松，成为建筑最好的装饰。
岩上窄院高于林木，视野极佳，可眺望山谷每一处。
从山外运来的青瓦铺上屋顶，每当云雾缭绕时，并不算大的建筑若隐若现，好似仙家洞府。
附近山沟有处滴水岩，清泉终年不绝，无须发愁生活用水。
丹炉被安置在新居一角，茅草屋与药田留在原地。
迟客没有给新住处题写名号，或许看透了吧。
带几只活鸡，送给黑蛇和狐狸当礼物，简简单单搬进新房屋，仍由书童和猎户陪伴，门墙边砌了新狗窝，不再是往日随风作响的简陋树皮。
炊烟再次升起，山居的日子如往日继续。
巨岩光滑，仿佛时光从未流逝。

迟客端坐老位置，诵读声清朗如初，偶尔也会因书中晦涩而蹙眉沉思。
黑蛇努力记住声音。
高处松树后，狐狸竖耳倾听。
如今迟客沉稳许多，相比那些形影相吊的隐居避世者，自己何其有幸，能与通灵黑蛇相伴，一同摸索那玄之又玄的长生，巧合下又与灵狐结识为友。
至少，自己接触到了真正修炼的一角。
即使角落全是妖。
山谷有黑蛇与狐狸，无须担忧被猛兽接近偷袭。
如果二兽能言语就更好了。
狐狸眼神最是灵动，时常静卧于松树后思考，比黑蛇聪明，火红皮毛里，仿佛天生便藏着三分灵智。
手中书卷翻一页，迟客皱眉。
“许多古籍都提到炼炁化神……可离肉身，但属阴，未纯阳，故称为阴神，乃思虑之神，可离肉身，只能夜游，而不能昼见，只自知，他人莫见……”
捧着书卷，反复研读，最终也只理解了七八分，书中大意，人的意识有可能脱离肉身束缚，自由外出，这种状态便被称作阴神。
当然，算不上真神，属于一种称呼，玄妙的超凡灵识状态。
尽管只是漫长道途中的一环，却是横亘在无数求道者面前的天堑，终其一生也难以触及。
“唉，修炼难啊……”
看了眼两位山中好友。
“二位也当勤勉修行，愿我们早日炼就阴神，将来一同夜游天地，遍览这月下山河。”
黑蛇听不懂，保持沉默就行。
content_en:
The fox has been living on the mountain peak recently and won't leave.
Black Snake's life track is still the same. He hunts for food in the afternoon, looks at the moon at night, and breathes mist at dawn. He is just a little uncomfortable without the sound of lectures. Occasionally, he will think of 'Brother Snake' who is good at calling and making sounds.
The forest is marked by the strong scent of tigers, and their huge figures often linger near the streams.
On a full-moon night, the black snake once left its body and observed the tiger from a dark perspective. Although it could avoid the tiger's perception, it could not get close as freely as it could to spy on other creatures.
I have met the fox several times, but still cannot communicate effectively.
The fox didn't want the tiger to stay in this mountainous area, but the simple-brained black snake didn't care at all.
Half a month later.
Experienced hunters brought groups of hounds into the mountains and soon found traces of tigers. The gongs and drums were noisy, dogs were barking and people roared, and the sound resounded through the mountains and forests. Finally, the tigers were driven away to several mountains.
The black snake's life is very monotonous, and other things have nothing to do with him and are easily forgotten.
The late visitor came back and brought many craftsmen with him.
A relatively protruding rock was selected on the side peak near the huge rock halfway up the mountain. From then on, the sound of rock-cutting could be heard during the day. From midsummer to autumn, a foot-wide path was cut out on the rock, and houses and high courtyard walls were built on the side peak rock according to the terrain with thick strips of stone. Although the houses and courtyards were not spacious, they were extremely strong.
The ancient pine trees with long roots on the rock were deliberately preserved to become the best decoration of the building.
The narrow courtyard on the rock is higher than the trees and has an excellent view. You can overlook every part of the valley.
The green tiles brought from outside the mountain are spread on the roof. Whenever the clouds and mist linger, the small building is looming, like a fairy cave.
There is a dripping rock in the nearby ravine with clear springs all year round, so there is no need to worry about domestic water.
The alchemy furnace was placed in a corner of the new home, while the thatched house and medicinal fields remained in place.
Chi Ke didn't inscribe a name on his new residence, maybe he saw through it.
He brought a few live chickens and gave them to the black snake and fox as gifts, and simply moved into the new house, still accompanied by the book boy and the hunter. A new doghouse was built next to the door wall, no longer the simple bark that rustled in the wind in the past.
Smoke rises again, and the days of living in the mountains continue as before.
The huge rocks are smooth, as if time has never passed.
Chi Ke sat in his usual seat, his reading voice as clear as ever, and occasionally he would frown in thought because of the obscurity of the book.
Black Snake tried to remember the sound.
High up behind the pine trees, the fox listened.
Nowadays, Chi Ke is much calmer. Compared with those who live in seclusion and hide from the world, he is so lucky to be accompanied by the psychic black snake, exploring the mysterious and mysterious immortality together, and by coincidence, he becomes friends with the spirit fox.
At least, I was exposed to a corner of true cultivation.
Even if the corners are full of monsters.
There are black snakes and foxes in the valley, so there is no need to worry about being attacked by wild beasts.
It would be better if the two beasts could speak.
The fox's eyes are the most intelligent. He often lies quietly behind the pine tree and thinks. He is smarter than the black snake. His fiery red fur seems to be born with a third level of intelligence hidden inside.
Chi Ke frowned as he turned a page of the book in his hand.
"Many ancient books mention that refining Qi to transform into gods... can leave the body, but it is Yin and not pure Yang, so it is called Yin God. It is the god of thinking. It can leave the body and can only travel at night, but cannot see during the day. It only knows itself and cannot be seen by others..."
I held the scroll and read it over and over, but in the end I only understood seven or eight points. The general idea in the book is that it is possible for human consciousness to break away from the constraints of the physical body and go out freely. This state is called Yin Shen.
Of course, it is not a true god, it belongs to a kind of title, a mysterious state of extraordinary spiritual consciousness.
Although it is only a link on a long road, it is a natural chasm that stands in front of countless seekers and will be difficult to reach in their lifetime.
"Alas, cultivation is difficult..."
He glanced at his two mountain friends.
"You two should also practice diligently. I hope we can cultivate Yin Shen as soon as possible. In the future, we can travel around the world at night and see the mountains and rivers under this moon."
Black Snake doesn't understand, so just stay silent.
